workflow.selector_prompt: Select the single Quecto repository workflow template, 'feature', before checking steps. If this is the post-completion handoff, first query the issue tracker for issues authored by the authenticated user only (for GitHub: gh issue list --author @me) and choose only from that filtered set.

templates.label: Feature
templates.description: New capability with local hook verification, BDD/TDD, code review, and merge.
templates.when_to_use: Use for all Quecto development work in this repository.

steps.label: Install/check local quality hooks
steps.guidance: Run scripts/install-hooks.sh, then verify pre-commit, pre-push, pre-merge-commit, and the git --no-verify wrapper are installed/active before editing code.

steps.label: Update Scenarios / Add new features
steps.guidance: Start by updating feature coverage and task-facing scenarios. Identify acceptance criteria.

steps.label: Write/update unit tests (run a quick smoke check; full suite runs on push)
steps.guidance: Write or update the unit tests for the change. Run a quick targeted smoke check to confirm they compile.

steps.label: Ensure new/modified tests FAIL (RED) — quick targeted run only, not full suite
steps.guidance: Run only the new/modified tests to confirm they fail before any implementation.

steps.label: Implement code (GREEN)
steps.guidance: Write the minimum code needed to satisfy the failing tests. Do NOT worry about the size of a change — implement it in full.

steps.label: Push (pre-push hook will run tests and linting)
Despatch sub agents in parallel as reviewers (Architecture, Security and Performance)
steps.guidance: Use the subagent tool in parallel mode to dispatch architecture-reviewer, security-reviewer, and performance-reviewer. Start each sub agent on its OWN workflow. Instruct every reviewer to ALWAYS leave its findings as inline comments on the PR in GitHub via the GraphQL API (addPullRequestReviewThread, anchored to the specific file and line), not merely as a summary.

steps.label: Reply to the reviewers comments on the PR and mark resolved (use graphql)
steps.guidance: Reply to every review comment on the PR, then resolve the threads using GraphQL mutations.

steps.label: Move to local master and pull
Clean up sub agents
steps.guidance: Terminate any sub agents spawned during this workflow now that it is complete (use agent_cmd to abort them, or get_subagents then kill each) so no orphaned sub agents remain.

guards.message: Complete hook setup and RED/GREEN work before committing.
Complete code review and pre-merge validation before merging.
